---
title: "Biochar Tree"
output: html_notebook
---


```{r respiration}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)     
library(emmeans) 
library(ggpubr) 
library(Matrix)


resp <- read_excel("C:/Users/jwl0037/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx", sheet="respiration", range="A1:E193")
head(resp)

resp <- resp %>%
  mutate(respiration = ifelse(replication == 2 & day == 2, NA, respiration))

#------------ 

resp$biochar_ratio <- as.factor(resp$biochar_ratio)
resp$day <- as.factor(resp$day)
resp$fertilizer <- as.factor(resp$fertilizer)

#------------ 

# Prepare data for both Biochar and Fertilizer plots
biochar_summary <- resp %>%
  group_by(biochar_ratio) %>%
  summarize(mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            se_resp = sd_resp / sqrt(n))

fert_summary <- resp %>%
  group_by(fertilizer) %>%
  summarize(mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            se_resp = sd_resp / sqrt(n))

# Make fertilizer levels ordered correctly
fert_summary$fertilizer <- factor(fert_summary$fertilizer, levels = c("fert-0", "fert-.5", "fert-1", "fert-2"))

# Combine the two summaries for easier plotting
biochar_summary$plot_type <- "Biochar"
fert_summary$plot_type <- "Fertilizer"

# Bind the data frames together
combined_summary <- bind_rows(biochar_summary, fert_summary)

# Plotting with facets
ggplot(combined_summary, aes(x = factor(ifelse(plot_type == "Biochar", biochar_ratio, fertilizer)), 
                             y = mean_resp, fill = plot_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_resp - se_resp, ymax = mean_resp + se_resp), width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  facet_wrap(~ plot_type, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Mean Respiration") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Biochar" = "#4DAF4A", "Fertilizer" = "#377EB8")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

#------------

# Prepare data for both Biochar and Fertilizer combined
combined_summary <- resp %>%
  group_by(biochar_ratio, fertilizer) %>%
  summarize(mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            se_resp = sd_resp / sqrt(n))

# Create a new column that combines the levels of biochar and fertilizer
combined_summary$biochar_fert_combined <- paste(combined_summary$biochar_ratio, 
                                                combined_summary$fertilizer, sep = " @ ")

# Ensure the x-axis is ordered first by biochar_ratio, then by fertilizer
combined_summary$biochar_fert_combined <- factor(combined_summary$biochar_fert_combined,
                                                 levels = c("0 @ fert-0", "0 @ fert-.5", "0 @ fert-1", "0 @ fert-2",
                                                            "25 @ fert-0", "25 @ fert-.5", "25 @ fert-1", "25 @ fert-2",
                                                            "50 @ fert-0", "50 @ fert-.5", "50 @ fert-1", "50 @ fert-2",
                                                            "100 @ fert-0", "100 @ fert-.5", "100 @ fert-1", "100 @ fert-2"))

# Plot
ggplot(combined_summary, aes(x = biochar_fert_combined, y = mean_resp, fill = biochar_fert_combined)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_resp - se_resp, ymax = mean_resp + se_resp), 
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  labs(x = "Biochar and Fertilizer Combinations", y = "Mean Respiration") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0 @ fert-0" = "#4DAF4A", "0 @ fert-.5" = "#4DAF4A", 
                               "0 @ fert-1" = "#4DAF4A", "0 @ fert-2" = "#4DAF4A",
                               "25 @ fert-0" = "#9B59B6", "25 @ fert-.5" = "#9B59B6", 
                               "25 @ fert-1" = "#9B59B6", "25 @ fert-2" = "#9B59B6",
                               "50 @ fert-0" = "#F39C12", "50 @ fert-.5" = "#F39C12", 
                               "50 @ fert-1" = "#F39C12", "50 @ fert-2" = "#F39C12",
                               "100 @ fert-0" = "#2C3E50", "100 @ fert-.5" = "#2C3E50", 
                               "100 @ fert-1" = "#2C3E50", "100 @ fert-2" = "#2C3E50")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# ----------

resp %>%
  group_by(fertilizer, biochar_ratio, day) %>%
  summarise(mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = sum(!is.na(respiration))) %>%
  arrange(fertilizer, biochar_ratio, day)

ggplot(resp, aes(x = day, y = respiration, color = factor(biochar_ratio))) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.1), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~fertilizer) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Respiration over Time",
       x = "Day",
       y = "Respiration Rate",
       color = "Biochar Ratio (%)")

#--------
 
resp_clean <- resp %>% filter(!is.na(respiration))

# Convert factors
resp_clean <- resp_clean %>%
  mutate(
    fertilizer = factor(fertilizer),
    biochar_ratio = factor(biochar_ratio),
    day = factor(day),
    replication = factor(replication)
  )

model_aov <- aov(respiration ~ fertilizer * biochar_ratio * day, data = resp_clean)
#TukeyHSD(model_aov, which = "fertilizer")

full_anova <- aov(respiration ~ fertilizer * biochar_ratio * day, data = resp)
summary(full_anova)

#TukeyHSD(full_anova, which ="fertilizer")
#TukeyHSD(full_anova, which ="biochar_ratio")
#TukeyHSD(full_anova, which ="fertilizer:biochar_ratio")
```



```{r RSR}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)     
library(emmeans) 
library(ggpubr) 
library(Matrix)

rsr <- read_excel("C:/Users/jwl0037/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx", sheet="rsr", range="A1:D49")
head(rsr)

# ------

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Filter for one species, e.g., 'sl'
rsr_sl <- rsr %>%
  filter(species == "sl") %>%
  mutate(fertilizer = factor(fertilizer, levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double")))

rsr_summary <- rsr_sl %>%
  group_by(biochar_ratio, fertilizer) %>%
  summarise(
    se_RSR = sd(mean_RSR, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

rsr$fertilizer <- factor(rsr$fertilizer, levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"))

# Plot bar graph with error bars
ggplot(rsr, aes(x = factor(biochar_ratio), y = mean_RSR, fill = fertilizer)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  facet_wrap(~ species) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Biochar Ratio (%)", 
       y = "Mean Root-to-Shoot Ratio per Tree", 
       title = "Mean RSR by Biochar Level and Fertilizer Across Species") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("none" = "#a6cee3", 
                               "half" = "#1f78b4", 
                               "full" = "#b2df8a", 
                               "double" = "#33a02c"))


# -------


# Make sure fertilizer and biochar_ratio are factors
rsr$fertilizer <- factor(rsr$fertilizer, levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"))
rsr$biochar_ratio <- factor(rsr$biochar_ratio, levels = c("0", "25", "50", "100"))
rsr$species <- factor(rsr$species)

# Run a two-way ANOVA with species as an additional factor:
#anova_rsr <- aov(mean_RSR ~ fertilizer * biochar_ratio * species, data = rsr)
#summary(anova_rsr)

#TukeyHSD(anova_rsr, which = "species")
#TukeyHSD(anova_rsr, which = "fertilizer")
#TukeyHSD(anova_rsr, which = "biochar_ratio")
#TukeyHSD(anova_rsr, which = "fertilizer:biochar_ratio")
#TukeyHSD(anova_rsr, which = "fertilizer:species")
#TukeyHSD(anova_rsr, which = "biochar_ratio:species")
#TukeyHSD(anova_rsr, which = "fertilizer:biochar_ratio:species")

# -------

rsr_model <- aov(mean_RSR ~ species + fertilizer + biochar_ratio, data = rsr)
summary(rsr_model)
#TukeyHSD(rsr_model, which = "species")
```



```{r survival}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)     
library(emmeans) 
library(ggpubr) 
library(Matrix)

surv_data <- read_excel("C:/Users/jwl0037/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx", sheet="survival", range="A1:F145")
head(survival)

surv_data <- surv_data %>%
  mutate(
    survival = as.numeric(survival),
    survival_rate = survival / seeded
  )

# Summarize survival rate by group
summary_data <- surv_data %>%
  group_by(species, fertilizer, `biochar_%`) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_survival = mean(survival_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_survival = sd(survival_rate, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )

summary_data$fertilizer <- factor(summary_data$fertilizer, levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"))

# Plot
ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = fertilizer, y = mean_survival, fill = factor(`biochar_%`))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_survival - se_survival, ymax = mean_survival + se_survival),
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ species) +
  labs(y = "Mean Survival Rate", x = "Fertilizer Treatment", fill = "Biochar %") +
  theme_minimal()

# ----------

surv_data$survival <- as.numeric(surv_data$survival)
surv_data$prop_survived <- surv_data$survival / surv_data$seeded

surv_data$fertilizer <- factor(surv_data$fertilizer, levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"))
surv_data$species <- factor(surv_data$species)
surv_data$biochar_percent <- as.factor(surv_data$`biochar_%`)

anova_surv <- aov(prop_survived ~ fertilizer * biochar_percent * species, data = surv_data)
summary(anova_surv)

#TukeyHSD(anova_surv, which = "species")
#TukeyHSD(anova_model, which = "fertilizer:biochar_percent")
#TukeyHSD(anova_surv, which = "fertilizer")
#TukeyHSD(anova_surv, which = "biochar_percent")
```
